charges.label: Base freight (per km, by billed weight band)
charges.quote: Base freight is charged per kilometre of the booked lane distance, according to the consignment's billed weight: up to and including 500 kg: ₹18.00 per km; 501 kg to 2,000 kg: ₹24.00 per km. Consignments above 2,000 kg are quoted case by case and are outside this rate card.

charges.label: Express service premium
charges.quote: Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

charges.label: Fuel surcharge
charges.quote: A fuel surcharge of 12% applies to the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).

charges.label: Residential delivery accessorial
charges.quote: Residential delivery (consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential): ₹250.00 flat per consignment.

document_rules.rule: The Carrier invoices fortnightly; payment is due 30 days from invoice date.
Billing disputes must be raised within 45 days of invoice date. Disputed line items are payable only on resolution; undisputed items remain due.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices. A credit note references the original consignment note number and states the invoice it corrects.

ambiguities.description: The base freight weight bands are written as 'up to and including 500 kg' (≤500) and '501 kg to 2,000 kg' (501–2000). This leaves the fractional interval strictly between 500 and 501 kg (e.g. 500.5 kg) uncovered by either band as literally written. Not closing this gap by assumption; the engine should report shipments with billed_weight_kg in this interval as undetermined.

notes: Encoded §1 base freight as a per-km rate tiered on billed_weight_kg (≤500kg: ₹18/km; 501-2000kg: ₹24/km; >2000kg: out_of_card per the contract's own case-by-case/quotation language). §2 express premium is 15% of base freight, applied only when service_level=express. §3 fuel surcharge is 12% of (base freight + express premium), unconditional. §4 residential accessorial (₹250 flat) applies when special_handling contains 'residential'; §5 makes the accessorial schedule closed (no charges for cold_chain, fragile, or any other unlisted handling/service — not treated as ambiguous since §5 explicitly disallows them). One ambiguity recorded: §1's literal weight bands (≤500 and 501-2000) leave the fractional interval (500, 501) kg uncovered; kept as written per instructions rather than closing the gap. §6-§8 captured as document_rules (fortnightly invoicing/30-day payment terms, 45-day dispute window, credit note mechanics) rather than priced charges.
